name: smart-faculty-profile-agent
description: Automated faculty profile builder for NAAC/NBA accreditation using IBM Granite on watsonx.ai.
author: AICTE Project

llm.use: Information extraction, profile generation, bio writing, correction merging

embedding.use: RAG chunk embedding for retrieval-augmented context

features: Upload PDFs, DOCX, Excel, CSV, and images
Text extraction with OCR fallback for scanned documents
RAG pipeline: chunk → embed → store → retrieve
Granite-powered structured extraction of 7 academic categories
Standardized profile and professional bio generation
Update mode: merge new documents with existing profile
Edit page: review and correct extracted data
Token usage dashboard for every Granite call
